name: responder-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is responder, a Python web framework built on Starlette (ASGI): routing
with path converters, function and class-based views, request and response objects with content
negotiation, hooks, dependency injection, sessions and security middleware, routers, OpenAPI
generation, typed runtime contracts and a set of extensions (authentication, rate limiting,
pagination, metrics, logging, GraphQL and generated clients).

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the responder package, that is the whole of responder/ (including responder/ext/ and responder/util/), together with README.md and the pages docs/source/api.rst, docs/source/tour.rst, docs/source/quickstart.rst, docs/source/guide-config.rst, docs/source/routers.rst, docs/source/runtime-contracts.rst, docs/source/testing.rst, docs/source/deployment.rst, docs/source/cli.rst, docs/source/clientgen.rst, docs/source/tutorial-auth.rst, docs/source/tutorial-flask.rst, docs/source/tutorial-middleware.rst, docs/source/tutorial-rest.rst, docs/source/tutorial-sqlalchemy.rst and docs/source/tutorial-websockets.rst, and the module, class and function docstrings of the package.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and
